stem: A controller commands a dehumidifier on, but independent humidity measurements do not respond. What can be concluded now?
choices: The dehumidifier compressor is definitely failed.
The humidity sensors are definitely wrong.
There is a command-to-response mismatch that needs equipment/control verification; root cause is not yet confirmed.
The controller display proves the equipment is working.
rationale: There is a command-to-response mismatch that needs equipment/control verification; root cause is not yet confirmed. This preserves the evidence and role boundary required by the referenced verification framework.
